A '''feather tree''' was a type of [[Tree/Legends|tree]]. They grew in the [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] [[Master Gardener]] [[Spero]]'s [[Spero's plant shop|shop]] in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Southern Underground/Legends|Southern Underground]].
